# beacon_monitor (Resource)

An uptime monitor (http, heartbeat, tcp, ping, dns or browser) on a status page. Unset optional+computed arguments take the server default (which can depend on your plan, e.g. `interval_minutes`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# HTTP check with keyword, cold-start retry and an office-hours check window.
resource "beacon_monitor" "api" {
  status_page         = beacon_status_page.main.slug
  name                = "API health"
  url                 = "https://api.example.com/health"
  keyword             = "ok"
  interval_minutes    = 5
  allow_cold_start    = true
  check_window_start  = "08:00"
  check_window_end    = "20:00"
  status_component_id = beacon_component.api.id
}

# Heartbeat (cron) monitor: ping heartbeat_url from your job.
resource "beacon_monitor" "backup" {
  status_page      = beacon_status_page.main.slug
  name             = "Nightly backup"
  type             = "heartbeat"
  interval_minutes = 1440
}

output "backup_ping_url" {
  value     = beacon_monitor.backup.heartbeat_url
  sensitive = true
}

resource "beacon_monitor" "db" {
  status_page = beacon_status_page.main.slug
  name        = "Postgres"
  type        = "tcp"
  host        = "db.example.com"
  port        = 5432
}

resource "beacon_monitor" "gateway" {
  status_page = beacon_status_page.main.slug
  name        = "Gateway ping"
  type        = "ping"
  host        = "gw.example.com"
}

resource "beacon_monitor" "mx" {
  status_page        = beacon_status_page.main.slug
  name               = "Mail DNS"
  type               = "dns"
  host               = "example.com"
  dns_record_type    = "MX"
  dns_expected_value = "mx1.example.com"
}

resource "beacon_monitor" "login" {
  status_page   = beacon_status_page.main.slug
  name          = "Login flow"
  type          = "browser" # Pro
  browser_steps = jsonencode([
    { action = "goto", url = "https://app.example.com/login" },
    { action = "fill", selector = "#email", value = "monitor@example.com" },
    { action = "fill", selector = "#password", value = "{{secret:LOGIN_PASSWORD}}" },
    { action = "click", selector = "button[type=submit]" },
    { action = "assert_text", text = "Dashboard" },
  ])
  browser_secrets = {
    LOGIN_PASSWORD = var.monitor_password
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `status_page` (String) Slug of the status page this belongs to (e.g. `beacon_status_page.main.slug`). Renaming the page's slug is followed in place; moving to a different page is not supported (taint the resource instead).

### Optional

- `allow_cold_start` (Boolean) Retry once with a longer timeout before failing (serverless hosts). Auto-enabled for known serverless hosts when unset.
- `browser_secrets` (Map of String, Sensitive) Values for `{{secret:NAME}}` placeholders in `browser_steps` (names in CAPS_WITH_UNDERSCORES). Write-only on the API: Beacon never returns them, so drift made outside Terraform isn't detected. Removing a key deletes that secret.
- `browser_steps` (String) Steps for `browser` monitors as a JSON array (use `jsonencode`). Actions: goto, click, fill, press, wait_for_selector, wait_for_url, assert_text, assert_status. Required for `browser`.
- `check_window_end` (String) Only check until this time (HH:MM).
- `check_window_start` (String) Only check from this time (HH:MM, page timezone). Set together with `check_window_end`.
- `cold_start_timeout_seconds` (Number) Timeout for the cold-start retry. Defaults to 30.
- `confirm_from_locations` (Boolean) Re-check from other regions before alerting. Defaults to `true`.
- `confirmation_quorum` (Number) Regions that must agree (1-10).
- `consecutive_threshold` (Number) Failed checks before the monitor is down. Defaults to 3.
- `dns_expected_value` (String) Expected DNS answer (optional).
- `dns_record_type` (String) `A`, `AAAA`, `CNAME`, `MX` or `TXT`. Required for `dns`.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Defaults to `true`.
- `expected_status_code` (Number) Defaults to 200.
- `expiry_alert_days` (String) Comma-separated days before expiry to alert, e.g. `14,7,1` (default). No spaces.
- `expiry_alerts_enabled` (Boolean) SSL/domain expiry alerts. Defaults to `true`.
- `host` (String) Hostname or IP. Required for `tcp`, `ping` and `dns`. Must be lowercase (the API lowercases it).
- `http_method` (String) `GET` (default) or `HEAD`.
- `interval_minutes` (Number) Minutes between checks. Default and minimum depend on your plan.
- `keyword` (String) Text that must (or must not) appear in the response body.
- `keyword_match_type` (String) `contains` (default) or `not_contains`.
- `port` (Number) Required for `tcp`.
- `status_component_id` (Number) Component (on the same page) whose status this monitor drives.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Defaults to 10.
- `type` (String) `http` (default), `heartbeat`, `tcp`, `ping`, `dns` or `browser` (Pro). Changing it replaces the monitor.
- `url` (String) URL to check. Required for `http`.

### Read-Only

- `heartbeat_url` (String, Sensitive) Ping URL for `heartbeat` monitors.
- `id` (String) Numeric id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <status_page_slug>/<monitor_id>
terraform import beacon_monitor.api acme-cloud/17
```
